row.question: How can I create an account?
row.answer: To create a Novagear account, go to the Novagear Customer Portal and click the 'Sign Up' button in the top-right corner. Fill in your company details, billing and shipping information, and a business email, then confirm your address and VAT/tax ID where applicable. Once submitted, your profile may go through a short verification step before you can place hardware orders or access our technical documentation.

row.question: What payment methods do you accept?
row.answer: Novagear primarily serves industrial and OEM customers, so we support multiple B2B payment options. You can pay using major credit and debit cards, secure bank transfers (ACH/SEPA/wire, depending on your region), and selected corporate payment platforms. For qualified accounts, we also offer invoice-based terms (such as net-30) subject to credit approval; details are provided during onboarding or by your Novagear sales representative.

row.question: How can I track my order?
row.answer: You can track your order by logging into your Novagear account and opening the 'Orders' or 'Order History' section. Each shipment includes a carrier name, tracking ID, and current status so you can see when your components leave our warehouse, arrive at regional hubs, and reach your facility. For large project or pallet shipments, your logistics contact or Novagear account manager can also share consolidated tracking and delivery schedules.

row.question: What is your return policy?
row.answer: Novagear accepts returns for most standard hardware items within 30 days of delivery, provided products are unused, in original packaging, and include all accessories and documentation. Because many orders are built for specific production lines, certain custom or configured-to-order parts may be non-returnable or subject to a restocking fee. Please refer to our Returns & RMA page for exact conditions and initiate a return request through your account or by contacting our support team to receive an RMA number before shipping anything back.

row.question: Can I cancel my order?
row.answer: Order cancellation depends on the production and fulfillment stage. You can usually cancel standard stock orders if they have not yet been picked or dispatched from the Novagear warehouse. For made-to-order or customized assemblies, cancellation may be limited or may incur charges once production has started. Contact Novagear customer support or your sales representative as soon as possible with your order number to review available options.

row.question: How long does shipping take?
row.answer: Shipping times vary based on your location, stock availability, and the shipping service chosen at checkout. For in-stock Novagear components, standard shipping typically takes 3–5 business days within the same region, while express options can be 1–2 business days. Palletized or freight shipments for large or heavy equipment may require additional handling time and can take longer depending on route and customs clearance; estimated delivery windows are shown during checkout and in your order confirmation.

row.question: Do you offer international shipping?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear ships hardware to many countries worldwide. During checkout, available shipping methods and costs are calculated based on your delivery address, order weight, and any special handling requirements. For cross-border B2B shipments, you may be responsible for import duties, taxes, and customs clearance, which will be outlined in your quotation or order confirmation where possible.

row.question: What should I do if my package is lost or damaged?
row.answer: If your Novagear shipment arrives damaged or appears lost in transit, contact customer support immediately with your order number, tracking ID, and photos of any visible damage to packaging or products. Our team will coordinate with the carrier to investigate, and depending on the findings, arrange a replacement shipment, partial replacement, or credit. Claims usually need to be raised within a defined time window after delivery, so please notify us as soon as you notice an issue.

row.question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
row.answer: If you need to update the shipping address for a Novagear order, reach out to customer support or your account manager as quickly as possible with the correct details. Address changes may be possible if the order has not yet been dispatched or handed over to the carrier. Once a shipment is in transit, rerouting options depend on the carrier’s policies and may involve additional fees or extended delivery times.

row.question: How can I contact customer support?
row.answer: You can contact Novagear customer support via email at [support email], by phone at [phone number], or through the contact form in your Novagear account portal. Our support team is available during standard business hours on working days, and can assist with product selection, technical questions, order status, RMAs, and billing inquiries. For key accounts, you may also have a dedicated account manager whose contact details are listed in your profile.

row.question: Do you offer gift wrapping services?
row.answer: Novagear focuses on industrial and professional hardware solutions, so gift wrapping is not typically offered for standard B2B shipments. If you require special packaging, branding, or neutral shipping for specific projects or partners, please discuss this with your sales representative before placing your order so we can review what is feasible and if any additional charges apply.

row.question: What is your price matching policy?
row.answer: Novagear aims to provide competitive pricing for industrial-grade components. If you receive a formal quote for an equivalent product from another authorized supplier, you can share the quotation with your Novagear representative for review. While price matching is not guaranteed—especially for custom or project-based configurations—we will assess the offer, overall project scope, and service conditions to propose the most competitive solution we can.

row.question: Can I order by phone?
row.answer: For traceability and configuration accuracy, Novagear generally processes orders through the online portal or via official purchase orders sent to our sales team. Your sales representative can discuss product options and then send you a formal quote, which you can convert into an order through the portal or your procurement system. In special cases, phone-assisted ordering may be supported, but written confirmation is always required before Novagear can release hardware to production or shipment.

row.question: Are my personal and payment details secure?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear uses industry-standard encryption and secure payment gateways to protect your personal and payment information during checkout and while stored in our systems. Access to your account and order data is restricted to authorized personnel only, and internal processes follow strict security and compliance practices appropriate for B2B and industrial transactions. You can further protect your account by using strong passwords and enabling any additional authentication methods we provide.

row.question: What is your price adjustment policy?
row.answer: Novagear provides a one-time price adjustment if a product you purchased is reduced in price or goes on sale within 7 days of your delivery. To request a price adjustment, contact Novagear customer support with your order details and proof of the current lower price. Eligible adjustments are typically refunded to your original payment method after verification. Custom orders or special project items may not qualify for this policy.

row.question: Do you have a loyalty program?
row.answer: Currently, Novagear prioritizes building long-term B2B partnerships and offers project-based incentives or volume agreements rather than a traditional loyalty points program. Large or repeat customers can discuss contract discounts, exclusive previews, and special support with their Novagear account manager. For the latest details on any rewards or referral programs, please visit our website or speak to your representative.

row.question: Can I order without creating an account?
row.answer: Novagear requires an account for all hardware orders to ensure accurate invoicing and compliance with B2B procurement standards. Registering lets you track shipments, download technical documents, and initiate support or warranty requests. If you are evaluating a one-time prototype or sample, please contact our sales team for possible guest checkout arrangements.

row.question: Do you offer bulk or wholesale discounts?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear specializes in serving OEMs and industrial customers, so we offer tiered or project-based discounts for bulk purchases. Discounts depend on order size, product type, and contract terms. Contact our sales team or check the Wholesale section on our website to discuss your volume requirements and get a customized offer.

row.question: Can I change or cancel an item in my order?
row.answer: If you need to change or cancel specific items in your Novagear order, reach out to our customer support team as soon as possible with your order number and the details. Changes or cancellations are supported if your order has not yet entered the production or shipping process. For custom or made-to-order products, options may be limited.

row.question: How can I leave a product review?
row.answer: To share feedback on a Novagear product, sign into your account and visit the product page. Click on 'Write a Review' and submit your rating and comments about your experience. Constructive feedback helps us improve product features and services for all B2B customers.

row.question: Can I use multiple promo codes on a single order?
row.answer: In most cases, Novagear allows only one promo or discount code per order. Enter the code during the checkout process in the designated field to apply your eligible discount. For contract customers, project discounts and promotions are managed via your account representative and cannot be combined with online codes.

row.question: What should I do if I receive the wrong item?
row.answer: If you receive an incorrect item in your Novagear shipment, notify our customer support team immediately with your order number and details. We will arrange to ship out the correct products and provide instructions for returning or handling the incorrect item. Resolving such issues quickly helps minimize any impact on your project timelines.

row.question: Do you offer expedited shipping?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear offers expedited and express shipping options for urgent orders. During checkout, select the desired expedited service based on your location and required delivery date. For time-sensitive industrial projects, contact your sales representative to discuss available express logistics solutions and cost estimates.

row.question: Can I order a product that is out of stock?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is temporarily out of stock, you can often sign up for restock notifications directly on the product page. For OEM or project customers, contact your account manager to discuss backorder options, lead times, or to reserve upcoming inventory.

row.question: What is your email newsletter about?
row.answer: Novagear’s email newsletter keeps subscribers informed about new industrial hardware releases, technical resources, company updates, and exclusive partner offers. Subscribe on our website to receive these updates and stay connected with the latest engineering insights and product launches.

row.question: Can I return a product if I changed my mind?
row.answer: You may return most Novagear products within 30 days if you change your mind, provided they are unused, in original packaging, and meet our return policy conditions. Some custom-built or configured-to-order items are excluded from change-of-mind returns. Review our Returns page for detailed eligibility and steps to initiate a request.

row.question: Do you offer live chat support?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear provides live chat support on our website during business hours. Look for the chat icon in the lower right corner, where you can connect with a support representative for prompt assistance with orders, product questions, or technical documentation.

row.question: Can I order a product as a gift?
row.answer: Novagear specializes in B2B and industrial supply, so personal gift services are not standard. However, you can designate a different shipping recipient or location for your order during checkout. If you have unique requirements for third-party delivery, contact customer support to discuss available options.

row.question: What should I do if my discount code is not working?
row.answer: If your Novagear discount or project code is not working, first verify that it is still valid, applies to the specific hardware category you are purchasing, and meets any minimum order quantities or values. Check for common issues such as expired dates, one-time use limits, or restrictions on already discounted or contract-priced items. If the code still fails, contact Novagear customer support or your account manager with a screenshot and your order details so the team can review and assist.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was a final sale item?
row.answer: Final sale or clearance items at Novagear are generally non-returnable and non-refundable, especially if they involve end-of-life hardware or specially priced stock. The product page and your order confirmation will indicate if an item is final sale. If you are unsure about the status of a specific item, please contact customer support before placing your order or to confirm whether any exceptions apply.

row.question: Do you offer installation services for your products?
row.answer: Novagear offers installation, commissioning, or on-site support services for selected product lines and larger industrial projects, often through certified service partners. Availability depends on your location, the type of equipment, and project scope. For more information, refer to the product documentation or contact our sales and support teams to discuss installation options and obtain a quote.

row.question: Can I order a product that is discontinued?
row.answer: Discontinued Novagear products are no longer manufactured or available for new orders. In many cases, compatible replacements or updated models are available. Your Novagear representative or customer support can help you identify suitable alternatives and assist with any required technical cross-references.

row.question: Can I return a product without a receipt?
row.answer: For Novagear orders, a receipt, invoice, or purchase order reference is usually required to process returns or warranty claims. If you ordered through a registered account, you can download copies of your documents directly from the portal. If you cannot locate your proof of purchase, contact customer support with as many details as possible so we can try to retrieve the order in our system.

row.question: Can I order a product for delivery to a different country?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear ships to multiple countries, subject to regional availability, export controls, and compliance requirements. During checkout, you can review supported destinations and shipping options for your selected products. For complex cross-border B2B shipments, including duties and documentation, please coordinate with your Novagear sales representative or support team.

row.question: Can I add a gift message to my order?
row.answer: Because Novagear focuses on B2B and industrial customers, dedicated gift messaging is not a standard feature. However, for certain shipments it may be possible to add a short reference or note in the delivery documentation. If you have special labeling or documentation requirements for your internal teams or end customers, please discuss them with customer support before placing the order.

row.question: Can I request a product demonstration before making a purchase?
row.answer: For selected Novagear solutions and larger projects, it may be possible to arrange a remote demo, sample units, or a technical walkthrough instead of a traditional in-person demonstration. Availability depends on the product family and your project scope. Contact our sales or technical team to discuss your use case, and they will advise on demo materials, evaluation kits, or reference installations.

row.question: Can I order a product that is listed as 'coming soon'?
row.answer: Products marked as 'coming soon' are in preparation for launch and not yet open for standard ordering in the Novagear portal. You can usually subscribe to notifications on the product page to be informed when ordering becomes available. For strategic or high-volume customers, your account manager may also be able to provide preliminary information on timelines and pre-launch planning.

row.question: Can I request an invoice for my order?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear issues invoices for all orders. Invoices are typically available for download in your account shortly after the order is processed and can also be attached to your shipment confirmation. If you need a revised invoice, a pro forma document, or an invoice sent to a different billing contact, please reach out to customer support with your order or PO number.

row.question: Can I order a product that is labeled as 'limited edition'?
row.answer: Novagear 'limited edition' or limited-run products have restricted availability and may only be produced in specific batches or for a defined timeframe. Orders are accepted while stock lasts, and once inventory is sold out, the item may not be restocked. If you plan to use a limited edition component in a long-term project, consult with our team about lifecycle and replacement options.

row.question: Can I return a product if I no longer have the original packaging?
row.answer: Returning Novagear products in their original packaging is preferred to protect components during transport and inspection. If you no longer have the original box, contact customer support before shipping anything back. In some cases, returns may still be accepted if items are securely packed and clearly labeled, but additional inspection or fees may apply.

row.question: Can I request a product that is currently out of stock to be reserved for me?
row.answer: Novagear does not generally reserve individual out-of-stock items for future delivery through the online store. However, project or frame agreements can include planned allocations or scheduled deliveries for key components. For ongoing or high-volume needs, speak with your account manager to plan supply and minimize stock-out risk.

row.question: Can I order a product that is listed as 'pre-order' with other in-stock items?
row.answer: Yes, you can place a combined order with pre-order and in-stock Novagear items. Depending on your region and chosen shipping method, the order may ship together once all items are available, or it may be split into multiple shipments. Any split-shipment rules or additional freight charges will be shown at checkout or communicated by your sales representative.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was damaged during shipping?
row.answer: If your Novagear shipment arrives damaged, please report it to customer support immediately, ideally within the timeframe indicated in your shipping documents. Provide photos of the packaging and the damaged items, along with your order and tracking numbers. Our team will coordinate with the carrier and guide you through replacement, repair, or credit options.

row.question: Can I request a product that is out of stock to be restocked?
row.answer: Novagear aims to restock high-demand products where possible, but restocking depends on component availability, product lifecycle, and overall demand. Use the notification feature on the product page to receive updates when stock returns. For critical or ongoing usage, contact your account manager to discuss long-term supply planning or suitable alternatives.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'backordered'?
row.answer: Yes, Novagear allows orders for many items that are on backorder. Your order will be queued and fulfilled once new stock arrives or production is completed. Estimated lead times and expected ship dates are typically shown at checkout or communicated on your order confirmation, and may be updated if supply conditions change.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased during a sale or with a discount?
row.answer: In most cases, Novagear accepts returns for eligible products purchased during promotions or with discounts, following the same return conditions as regular-priced items. Refunds are processed based on the price you actually paid after discounts. Certain promotional, clearance, or final sale items may be excluded, so please review the specific campaign terms and our return policy.

row.question: Can I request a product repair or replacement if it is damaged?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is damaged or fails within the applicable warranty period, contact customer support or your account manager with details, photos, and the serial or batch number where available. Our team will evaluate the claim and advise whether repair, replacement, or another remedy is appropriate under the warranty terms. In some cases, an RMA and return inspection may be required.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'out of stock' but available for pre-order?
row.answer: If a Novagear item is marked as out of stock but available for pre-order, you can place an order to secure units from the next production or restock batch. Your order will ship once inventory is available, according to the estimated lead time shown at checkout or on your order confirmation.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased as a gift?
row.answer: Yes, products purchased from Novagear as gifts can generally be returned if they meet our standard return conditions. However, any refund is normally issued to the original payment method used for the purchase. If the recipient needs to handle the return directly, customer support can explain the process and any documentation required.

row.question: Can I request a product if it is listed as 'discontinued'?
row.answer: Once a Novagear product is listed as discontinued, it is no longer available for new orders. Our team can help you identify successor models, compatible alternatives, or migration paths if you rely on the discontinued item in existing designs. Contact your Novagear representative or support team with the part number and application details to get recommendations.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'sold out'?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is listed as 'sold out', it is currently unavailable for new orders because existing stock and any planned production batches have been fully allocated. You can check the product page for notes about successor models or alternatives. In some cases, your Novagear representative may be able to suggest replacement parts or migration options for ongoing projects.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased with a gift card?
row.answer: Yes, eligible Novagear products purchased using a gift card or store credit can generally be returned under our standard return policy. Any approved refund for these orders is typically reissued as store credit or a new gift card rather than cash. For specific cases or partial refunds on mixed-payment orders, please contact customer support.

row.question: Can I request a product if it is not currently available in my size?
row.answer: Because Novagear focuses on industrial hardware rather than apparel, product options are usually defined by technical specifications such as dimensions, ratings, or connector types instead of sizes. If a particular variant or configuration is unavailable, it may be temporarily out of stock or end-of-life. Contact our team with the exact part number and requirements so we can advise on restock timelines or suitable alternatives.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'coming soon' but available for pre-order?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is marked as 'coming soon' and offers a pre-order option, you can place an order to secure units from the first production batch. Your order will be queued and shipped once the product is officially released and inventory becomes available. Estimated release dates or lead times will be shown at checkout or communicated in your order confirmation.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased with a discount code?
row.answer: In most cases, Novagear accepts returns for eligible products purchased using discount or promo codes, subject to our standard return conditions. Any refund is calculated based on the actual amount paid after discounts, not the original list price. Certain promotional or clearance campaigns may have different rules, so please review the specific terms associated with your discount.

row.question: Can I request a custom order or personalized product?
row.answer: Novagear can support custom builds, configuration services, or special labeling for certain hardware families and project volumes. Availability depends on technical feasibility, minimum order quantities, and lead times. Share your requirements with our sales or engineering team so they can assess options, including custom part numbers, kitting, or tailored assemblies.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'temporarily unavailable'?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is marked as 'temporarily unavailable', it is not currently open for ordering due to stock, sourcing, or quality review constraints. The product page may indicate whether restocking is planned. You can monitor the status, sign up for notifications if available, or contact your account manager for alternatives or updated availability information.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was damaged due to improper use?
row.answer: Novagear’s return and warranty policies typically cover defects in materials or workmanship and damage occurring under normal, intended use. Damage caused by misuse, incorrect installation, or operation outside specified ratings is generally not eligible for return or free replacement. However, you can still reach out to our support team to review the situation and discuss possible repair or paid replacement options.

row.question: Can I request a product if it is listed as 'coming soon' but not available for pre-order?
row.answer: When a Novagear product is labeled 'coming soon' without a pre-order option, it is still in preparation for launch and cannot yet be ordered. You may be able to subscribe to updates on the product page or discuss roadmap and timing with your Novagear representative. Once the product is released, it will become available for standard ordering in the portal.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'on hold'?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is listed as 'on hold', it is temporarily unavailable for purchase, often due to quality checks, design changes, or regulatory reviews. During this period, new orders are typically blocked. Please contact customer support or your account manager to understand the reason for the hold and get advice on alternative parts or expected timelines.

row.question: Can I return a product if I no longer have the original receipt?
row.answer: While having the original invoice or receipt simplifies the process, Novagear may still be able to help if you no longer have it. If you ordered through a registered account, your documents and order history can usually be retrieved from the portal. Otherwise, provide customer support with details such as company name, approximate date, and product information so we can try to locate the transaction.

row.question: Can I request a product that is listed as 'limited edition' to be restocked?
row.answer: Limited edition Novagear products are produced in restricted quantities or for a defined period, so once they are sold out they are usually not restocked. If you rely on a limited edition item for a project, our team can help you evaluate alternative standard products or discuss long-term availability plans where possible.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'discontinued' but still visible on the website?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is marked as 'discontinued' but still appears online, it is displayed for reference and documentation only and cannot be ordered. The page may point to replacement parts or newer generations. If something seems unclear, contact customer support or your sales representative for clarification and recommended alternatives.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was a clearance or final sale item?
row.answer: Clearance and final sale Novagear items are typically non-returnable and non-refundable, especially when they involve end-of-line stock. Any such restrictions are indicated on the product page and during checkout. If you have questions about a particular clearance item before purchasing, please confirm the conditions with customer support.

row.question: Can I request a product if it is not listed on your website?
row.answer: If a specific part or configuration is not listed on the Novagear website, it may be a custom item, legacy product, or something outside the current catalog. Provide your requirements, drawings, or competitor part numbers to our sales or technical team, and they will check whether a suitable Novagear solution exists or if a custom option can be proposed.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'out of stock' but available for backorder?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is out of stock but supports backorders, you can place an order to reserve units from incoming inventory or the next production run. Your order will ship once stock is replenished, and indicative lead times or expected ship dates will be provided at checkout or in your order confirmation.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased as part of a bundle or set?
row.answer: Return options for Novagear bundles and kits depend on how they were sold. In many cases, the entire bundle must be returned complete, including all components and documentation, to qualify for a refund. For complex kits or project-specific bundles, please review the terms on your quote or contact customer support to understand what can be returned and under which conditions.

row.question: Can I request a product that is listed as 'out of stock' to be restocked?
row.answer: Novagear aims to restock high-demand products whenever feasible, but restocking depends on supplier availability, lifecycle status, and forecasted demand. Use the notification feature on the product page where available, and for critical applications, work with your account manager to plan supply or identify alternative part numbers.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'coming soon' and available for pre-order?
row.answer: Yes, if a Novagear product is labeled 'coming soon' and allows pre-orders, you can place an order to secure your allocation in advance of the official release. Your items will ship once production is complete and stock is ready, in line with the estimated schedule communicated during checkout or in your confirmation.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was damaged due to mishandling during shipping?
row.answer: If a Novagear shipment appears to have been mishandled in transit and your products are damaged, report the issue to customer support immediately, ideally with photos of the packaging and items. Our team will work with the logistics provider to file a claim and will guide you through replacement, repair, or credit options according to our policy and the carrier’s investigation.

row.question: Can I request a product that is listed as 'out of stock' to be reserved for me?
row.answer: Novagear does not usually reserve individual out-of-stock items via the online store. For ongoing projects or larger volumes, however, you can discuss scheduled deliveries or allocation planning with your account manager through a frame or project agreement. This helps ensure future availability of critical components.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'pre-order' but available for backorder?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is shown as 'pre-order' and supports backorders, you can submit an order to secure your place in the queue for upcoming stock. Whether labeled pre-order or backorder, your hardware will ship once inventory becomes available, following the indicative lead times shared at purchase.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased with store credit?
row.answer: Yes, eligible Novagear products bought using store credit can generally be returned according to our standard return policy. Approved refunds for such orders are typically issued back as store credit, which you can use on future purchases. For orders with mixed payment methods, customer support can explain how the refund will be allocated.

row.question: Can I request a product that is currently out of stock to be restocked?
row.answer: When a Novagear product is out of stock, restocking will depend on whether it remains an active item and on component availability. You can subscribe to inventory notifications on the product page if available, and for key components used in your designs, you should coordinate with your account manager to discuss demand forecasts and supply options.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'sold out' but available for pre-order?
row.answer: If a Novagear product is shown as 'sold out' yet still offers a pre-order option, you can place an order to secure units from a future production batch. Your order will be fulfilled once new inventory arrives, and expected lead times will be indicated during checkout or in subsequent communications.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased with a promotional gift card?
row.answer: Yes, products purchased at Novagear using a promotional gift card can typically be returned if they meet our standard return criteria. Any approved refund is usually issued as store credit or a new gift card rather than cash. Specific promotional campaigns may have additional conditions, so please review their terms or contact support.

row.question: Can I request a product if it is not currently available in my preferred color?
row.answer: For Novagear hardware, variations are more often based on specifications than color, but when aesthetic options exist, certain colors or finishes may have limited or intermittent availability. If your preferred variant is unavailable, you can check back later or ask our team whether additional batches are planned. They can also suggest equivalent products with similar technical performance.

row.question: Can I order a product if it is listed as 'coming soon' and not available for pre-order?
row.answer: When a Novagear product is marked 'coming soon' without a pre-order option, orders cannot be placed until the product is officially released. You may follow announcements or subscribe to updates where available. Once order entry opens, you can purchase the product through the usual channels or via your account manager.

row.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased during a promotional event?
row.answer: In general, Novagear accepts returns for qualifying products bought during promotional events, subject to the same conditions as regular orders. Refunds are processed based on the promotional price you paid, after any discounts. Some special campaigns or clearance promotions may have stricter rules, so always review the event terms or consult customer support if unsure.

row.question: How can I reset my password?
row.answer: To reset your Novagear portal password, go to the login page and click the 'Forgot Password' link. Enter the business email associated with your account and follow the link sent to you to create a new password. If you do not receive the email within a few minutes or your account is managed centrally by your company, please contact your internal administrator or Novagear support for assistance.

row.question: How do I update my account information?
row.answer: To update your Novagear account details, sign in and navigate to the 'Account Settings' or 'Profile' section. There you can edit contact information, company details, billing and shipping addresses, and communication preferences. If certain fields are locked due to contract or compliance reasons, please contact your Novagear account manager or support team to request changes.

row.question: What is your privacy policy?
row.answer: Novagear’s privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect data such as your contact details, order history, and portal activity. It also describes your rights regarding data access, correction, and deletion. For full, up-to-date information, please visit the Privacy Policy page on our website or contact us if you have specific compliance or data protection questions.

row.question: Can I change my order after it has been placed?
row.answer: If you need to adjust a Novagear order, contact customer support or your sales representative as soon as possible with your order number and the requested changes. Modifications are generally possible only before the order enters the picking, production, or shipment stage. For custom-built or configured components, options may be more limited once processing has started.

row.question: How do I unsubscribe from your newsletter?
row.answer: To unsubscribe from Novagear marketing emails, click the 'Unsubscribe' or 'Manage Preferences' link at the bottom of any newsletter and follow the prompts. You can also adjust your communication preferences in your account settings. You may still receive essential transactional messages about orders, invoices, or account security even after opting out of marketing content.

row.question: What are your business hours?
row.answer: Novagear’s standard customer support hours are [working hours, e.g., Monday–Friday, 9:00–17:00, local time zone]. During these hours, our team is available to assist with technical questions, quotations, orders, logistics, and after-sales support. For urgent issues outside these hours, please refer to your contract documentation or any dedicated escalation contacts provided.

row.question: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?
row.answer: Novagear stands behind the quality of its hardware and aims for a high level of customer satisfaction. If you are not satisfied with a product’s performance or it does not meet the agreed specifications, contact our support or your account manager to review the situation. Depending on the case and applicable policies, we may offer troubleshooting, replacement, or return options.

row.question: How can I apply for a job at your company?
row.answer: To explore career opportunities at Novagear, visit the Careers section on our website. There you can review current openings in engineering, operations, sales, and other departments, and submit your application and resume through the online form. If no suitable role is listed, you may also be able to send a speculative application, depending on the region.

row.question: What is the warranty on your products?
row.answer: Warranty coverage for Novagear products depends on the specific hardware category and region. Typical warranties cover defects in materials and workmanship for a defined period from the date of delivery, provided products are used within their specified ratings and guidelines. Detailed warranty terms are available on each product page or in the accompanying documentation, and our support team can clarify coverage for particular part numbers.

row.question: Can I request a refund if the price drops after my purchase?
row.answer: If the price of a Novagear product decreases shortly after your order, you may be eligible for a one-time price adjustment within a defined time window, such as 7 days from delivery. To request a review, contact customer support with your order number and details of the new price. Eligibility and refund options may vary depending on the product type, contract terms, and promotion conditions.

row.question: How can I reset my password?
row.answer: To reset your Novagear portal password, go to the login page and click the 'Forgot Password' link. Enter the business email associated with your account and follow the link sent to you to create a new password. If you do not receive the email within a few minutes or your account is managed centrally by your company, please contact your internal administrator or Novagear support for assistance.

row.question: How do I update my account information?
row.answer: To update your Novagear account details, sign in and navigate to the 'Account Settings' or 'Profile' section. There you can edit contact information, company details, billing and shipping addresses, and communication preferences. If certain fields are locked due to contract or compliance reasons, please contact your Novagear account manager or support team to request changes.

row.question: What is your privacy policy?
row.answer: Novagear’s privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect data such as your contact details, order history, and portal activity. It also describes your rights regarding data access, correction, and deletion. For full, up-to-date information, please visit the Privacy Policy page on our website or contact us if you have specific compliance or data protection questions.

row.question: Can I change my order after it has been placed?
row.answer: If you need to adjust a Novagear order, contact customer support or your sales representative as soon as possible with your order number and the requested changes. Modifications are generally possible only before the order enters the picking, production, or shipment stage. For custom-built or configured components, options may be more limited once processing has started.

row.question: How can I find the correct replacement part or spare for my Novagear product?
row.answer: To identify the correct replacement part or spare, check the product label or nameplate on your Novagear device for the full model number and, if available, the serial or batch code. Then search this identifier in the Novagear catalog or portal, where compatible accessories and spare modules are listed, or share the information with our technical support team. Providing photos of the rating plate and the installation environment helps us recommend a technically compatible replacement that meets the original electrical and mechanical specifications.

row.question: Where can I download datasheets and technical documentation for Novagear hardware?
row.answer: Datasheets, 2D/3D CAD files, wiring diagrams, and manuals for Novagear products are available on the product detail pages in our online catalog or customer portal. After locating your specific part number, you can download the latest documentation in PDF or CAD formats. If you require legacy documentation for older revisions, contact technical support with the part number and approximate purchase date.

row.question: How do I know if a Novagear product is certified for my region or industry standard?
row.answer: Certification information such as CE, UKCA, UL, CSA, or other regional and industry-specific approvals is typically printed on the product label and listed in the datasheet. In the technical documentation, you will find details about standards for safety, EMC, ingress protection (IP rating), and temperature class where applicable. If your project requires proof of conformity or declarations (for example, Declarations of Conformity), our support team can provide the relevant documents upon request.

row.question: What environmental conditions do Novagear products support (temperature, humidity, IP rating)?
row.answer: Each Novagear product specifies its approved operating and storage temperature ranges, permissible relative humidity, and ingress protection (IP) rating in the datasheet or manual. Typical industrial components support wide temperature ranges and are rated for installation in control cabinets or field environments, depending on the product family. Always ensure the actual operating environment stays within these limits to maintain performance, lifetime, and warranty coverage.

row.question: How do I install or mount Novagear hardware correctly?
row.answer: Installation instructions, including mounting orientation, required clearances for cooling, torque values for screws or terminals, and recommended accessories (such as DIN rail types or brackets), are included in the product manual. Before installation, verify that supply voltage, wiring, and grounding match the specifications and follow all safety guidelines, including disconnecting power before working on the system. For complex systems or high-power equipment, Novagear recommends installation by qualified personnel familiar with local electrical codes.

row.question: How can I troubleshoot a Novagear device that is not powering on?
row.answer: If a Novagear device does not power on, first confirm that the input supply voltage, polarity, and frequency match the values specified on the product label and in the datasheet. Check upstream protection devices (such as fuses, breakers, and power supplies), verify that all connectors are firmly seated, and inspect for visible damage or loose wiring. If the device still fails to start, document any status indicators and measurements, then contact Novagear technical support for detailed diagnostics.

row.question: What should I do if my Novagear product overheats or shuts down under load?
row.answer: If a Novagear product overheats or shuts down, verify that it is operating within its specified load, ambient temperature, and installation conditions. Ensure that ventilation openings are not obstructed, adequate spacing is maintained between neighboring components, and any required heatsinks or cooling fans are correctly installed and functioning. Persistent thermal issues may indicate oversizing requirements or a fault; in such cases, record operating conditions and contact technical support for further analysis.

row.question: How do I check compatibility between Novagear components and third-party equipment?
row.answer: To confirm compatibility, compare key technical parameters such as voltage and current ratings, communication interfaces (for example, Ethernet, RS-485, industrial fieldbuses), connector types, and mechanical form factors between the Novagear product and the third-party device. The Novagear datasheet and manual list these parameters and include recommended wiring or interface diagrams. For complex integrations or safety-related applications, share your system schematic with our engineering support team for a compatibility review.

row.question: How can I obtain firmware or configuration updates for Novagear products?
row.answer: For products that support firmware or configuration updates, the latest approved firmware versions and tools are usually available through the Novagear customer portal or on the product page under 'Downloads.' Before updating, review the release notes, follow the documented update procedure, and back up your existing configuration where possible. In critical systems, Novagear recommends testing firmware updates in a non-production environment before rolling them out broadly.

row.question: What is the difference between standard-duty and heavy-duty Novagear variants?
row.answer: Standard-duty Novagear variants are designed for typical industrial environments and load profiles, while heavy-duty versions are engineered for more demanding conditions, such as higher inrush currents, frequent switching, or harsh environmental exposure. Heavy-duty models may offer enhanced materials, improved thermal design, extended electrical ratings, or additional certifications. The product comparison table and datasheets outline these differences so you can choose the most suitable option for your application.

row.question: How do I start an RMA (Return Material Authorization) for a suspected defective Novagear product?
row.answer: If you suspect a Novagear product is defective, first collect key information such as the part number, serial or batch number, installation date, and a description of the issue including any diagnostic steps already taken. Contact Novagear technical support or submit a ticket through the customer portal; our team will help you troubleshoot the issue remotely. If a hardware fault is confirmed and the product is within its warranty period, you will be issued an RMA number and instructions for returning the device for repair or replacement.

row.question: What export regulations and compliance requirements apply when shipping Novagear products internationally?
row.answer: When exporting Novagear products, customers must comply with all applicable international trade regulations, including export control laws, customs documentation requirements, and any applicable sanctions or embargo restrictions. It is important to verify whether the product is subject to export classification codes such as ECCN and ensure proper licensing if required. Customers should also prepare accurate commercial invoices, declare the correct value and origin of goods, and confirm that the destination country permits the import of the product. Novagear can provide guidance on product classifications and necessary documentation, but the exporter is ultimately responsible for ensuring full compliance with local and international regulations.
